answer: An invitation is only renewed when the invited identity has produced work that a stranger attested, so waiting out a quarantine window is worthless and only per-identity attested work ages an account into the trusted tier. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. The wharf is the attested output, the signal the stranger who checks it, and the kernel the tier the pair unlocks; the wharf is per identity, the signal cannot be the farm's own, and the kernel is what waiting alone cannot buy.
